title: Papuma change record (logical form)
description: The storage-neutral shape of one change feed entry. The PostgreSQL columns of docs/feed-wire-format.md are one realisation of it. See docs/spec/changes.md.

seq.description: Identity of the record within one store. Not a cursor and not a watermark; do not order or skip by it.

documentType.description: Logical document type name from the metamodel.

version.description: Document version after this change. Gapless per document, starting at 1.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version of the diff content. History is never upcast retroactively.

actorId.description: Who caused the change; empty when not provided.

metadata.description: correlationId, optional causationId / causationType / traceparent, rollback markers. Open object.
